patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Prior bearish structure broken by impulsive rally from ~1725 to ~1850; higher high and higher low established above previous downtrend resistance.

patterns_found.name: Bullish Flag
patterns_found.evidence: Sharp vertical rally from ~1725 to ~1850 followed by tight sideways consolidation near the highs.

patterns_found.name: Double Bottom
patterns_found.evidence: Two distinct swing lows near ~1725 separated by a rally; price has already broken above the neckline around ~1775.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: Price reversed from ~1725 lows, broke above 1800 resistance, and is consolidating near 1825-1850 after an impulsive rally. Volume spikes accompanied the upward move.
limitations: 15m chart noise may invalidate intraday patterns quickly.
